_comment: Each entry is a PRESET STEP: the animation beside it, plus the name and note shown wherever it is used. To add one: drop <slug>.json here (lowercase letters, digits and underscores), add its entry below, commit. The backend picks it up on its next start; no migration and no client release. `order` is the order the library is offered in, grouped by station: 100s espresso, 200s milk, 300s brew and tea, 400s pours and mixing, 500s cold bar, 600s finishing, 700s kitchen, 800s ice cream, 900s serving.

weigh.name: Weigh the dose
weigh.note: Check the grams before you tamp

tamp.name: Tamp
tamp.note: Level it, then one firm press

lock_in.name: Lock in the portafilter
lock_in.note: Seat it and twist until it stops

purge.name: Purge the group head
purge.note: A short flush before the shot

pull_shot.name: Pull espresso shot
pull_shot.note: Check the time and the grams

knock_out.name: Knock out the puck
knock_out.note: One firm strike into the knock box
knock_out.note_ar: طرقة واحدة قوية في صندوق التفريغ

decant_milk.name: Pour milk into the pitcher
decant_milk.note: Only as much as the drink needs

steam_milk.name: Steam milk
steam_milk.note: Heat and texture to the drink's spec
steam_milk.note_ar: سخّن واضبط قوام الرغوة حسب المشروب

tap_pitcher.name: Swirl and tap the pitcher
tap_pitcher.note: Knock the bubbles out until it shines

latte_art.name: Latte art
latte_art.note: Pour steadily and finish with the pattern

stencil_dust.name: Dust through a stencil
stencil_dust.note: Hold it steady, lift it straight up

wipe_wand.name: Wipe the steam wand
wipe_wand.note: Wipe and purge after every jug
wipe_wand.note_ar: امسح وأفرغ البخار بعد كل إبريق

pour_over.name: Pour over
pour_over.note: Pour in slow circles from the centre

brew_pot.name: Fill the teapot
brew_pot.note: Fill from the kettle and let it brew

steep.name: Steep
steep.note: Steep for the time on the recipe

lift_infuser.name: Lift the infuser
lift_infuser.note: Lift it out and let it drain

pour_liquid.name: Pour
pour_liquid.note: Pour to the line for this size

pour_sparkling.name: Top with sparkling
pour_sparkling.note: Top up last so it keeps its fizz
pour_sparkling.note_ar: أضفها في النهاية للحفاظ على الفوران

strain.name: Strain
strain.note: Strain so the ice stays behind

layer_pour.name: Layer the pour
layer_pour.note: Pour over a spoon so the layer holds
layer_pour.note_ar: صب فوق ملعقة ليبقى الفصل بين الطبقات

rim_glass.name: Rim the cup
rim_glass.note: Press the rim in evenly all the way round
rim_glass.note_ar: اضغط الحافة بالتساوي من كل الجهات

ladle_boba.name: Add boba pearls
ladle_boba.note: One ladle into the bottom of the cup

drop_in.name: Drop in fruit or pearls
drop_in.note: Drop them in whole and let them sink

whipped_cream.name: Whipped cream
whipped_cream.note: Swirl it up to a peak

garnish.name: Garnish
garnish.note: Last thing on, before the lid

slice_ingredient.name: Slice an ingredient
slice_ingredient.note: Even slices, all the same thickness

bake.name: Bake
bake.note: Into the oven for the time on the recipe
bake.note_ar: أدخله الفرن للمدة المذكورة في الوصفة

soft_serve.name: Soft serve
soft_serve.note: Pull the lever and build the swirl

lid.name: Put the lid on
lid.note: Press until it seats all the way round
lid.note_ar: اضغط حتى يثبت من كل الجهات

sleeve.name: Add a sleeve
sleeve.note: Slide it up on every hot cup

label.name: Label the cup
label.note: Face the label to the customer

carrier.name: Into the carrier
carrier.note: Two or more cups go in a carrier
carrier.note_ar: كوبان أو أكثر توضع في حامل

hand_over.name: Hand it over
hand_over.note: Call the name and hand it over
